from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545456/attempts/2b17c2b4a8284089bbeaca60201f4326/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2baeadf3.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Extend the terminal contiguous run of foreground color to the right edge
    # only when that run has at least four cells.
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = len(row) - 1
        while c >= 0 and row[c] == bg:
            c -= 1
        if c < 0:
            continue
        color = row[c]
        start = c
        while start >= 0 and row[start] == color:
            start -= 1
        if c - start >= 4:
            for k in range(c + 1, len(row)):
                out[r][k] = 1
    return out
''')
print(p.read_text())
